summary: The change correctly normalizes current matrix job names and recognizes timestamp-prefixed Actions error lines, with focused regression coverage; no actionable defects were found.

evidence: `ops/self-defects.ts` now maps each current `test-shards` matrix display name, including worker counts, to the logical `test-shards` job instead of `unknown-job`.
`extractSelfFailureSignature` now recognizes timestamp-prefixed and `##[error]`-annotated generic error lines, replacing the no-allowlisted-pattern fallback for the reported log shape.
New unit and hosted-applier tests cover current matrix names, timestamped errors, sanitized issue filing, and deduplication with legacy display names.
